ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the central atom is a carbonyl carbon, above is O forming C=O with the central carbon; on the left side of the central carbon is connected a sulfur atom labeled with H, that is, an S-H fragment; on the right side of the central carbon is connected another sulfur atom, and this sulfur is further connected to the right to a carbon-chain terminal group, which can be represented as S-CH3. There are curved arrows in the figure indicating electron rearrangement: the electrons of the left sulfur-containing fragment are used to form a double bond between the central carbon and the left sulfur, and the bond between the right central carbon and the methylthio sulfur breaks, with the electrons moving onto the right sulfur. Then reason: retaining the double bond C=O between the central carbon and oxygen, while the left C-S single bond becomes C=S, therefore the product containing the central carbon is carbonyl sulfide, with SMILES O=C=S. The departing methylthio sulfur on the right obtains H in the context of proton transfer/electron rearrangement, becoming methanethiol, with SMILES CS. The two products are unconnected molecules, connected with a dot, so the result is O=C=S.CS.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify O=C at the center, S-H on the left, and S-CH3 on the right, plus curved arrows. Then apply each arrow: make the left C-S bond into C=S, keep C=O, and break the bond from the carbonyl carbon to the methylthio sulfur. Assign the H to the leaving methylthio sulfur as shown by the electron relocation/proton transfer context. The carbonyl carbon fragment becomes carbonyl sulfide, O=C=S, and the methyl sulfur fragment becomes methanethiol, CS. Combine disconnected products with a dot: O=C=S.CS.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中中心原子是羰基碳，上方为 O 与中心碳形成 C=O；中心碳左侧连着一个带 H 标注的硫原子，即 S-H 片段；中心碳右侧连着另一个硫原子，该硫再向右连到一条碳链端基，可表示为 S-CH3。图中有弯箭头表示电子重排：左侧含硫片段的电子用于形成中心碳与左硫之间的双键，右侧中心碳与甲硫基硫之间的键断开，电子移到右侧硫上。再推理：保留中心碳与氧的双键 C=O，同时左侧 C-S 单键变为 C=S，因此含中心碳的产物是 carbonyl sulfide，SMILES 为 O=C=S。右侧离去的甲硫基硫在质子转移/电子重排语境下获得 H，成为 methanethiol，SMILES 为 CS。两个产物是不相连的分子，用点号连接，所以结果为 O=C=S.CS。
